_comment: The rec-dup finding's port of Fusion's matching code (majkinetor, userscripts/fusion/fusion.user.js). 'decls' are Fusion's top-level declarations in the order the port lists them; each is copied verbatim, only the identifiers in 'rename' replaced. Read by scripts/gen-fusion-port.py (writes the section) and scripts/check-fusion-port.js (compares the section with the clone). 'settings' are the SETTINGS_DEFAULTS values the port fixes as _FZ_SETTINGS. Fusion's own comment above each declaration is not copied; its JSDoc here names the issue.

decls.name: normName
tokenMatch
levenshtein
fuzzyRatio
titleAlike
decls.doc:
Fusion's "titles alike": token overlap of at least 0.6, or a fuzzy ratio of at least 0.85.
@type {function(string, string): boolean}

decls.name: TITLE_QUALIFIERS
decls.doc:
Words that only name a mix, edit or edition; `_fzTitleDistinctWords()` never counts them as a difference (Fusion's, #760).
@type {Set<string>}

decls.name: isNumberWord
decls.doc:
A digit run or a short Roman numeral: never paired off as a typo, so "Dwell I" stays apart from "Dwell IV" (Fusion's).
@type {function(string): boolean}

decls.name: titleDistinctWords
isrcStem
decls.doc:
An ISRC's first seven characters: country, registrant and year (Fusion's).
@type {function(string): string}

decls.name: isrcConflict
placeText
decls.doc:
A place or area as a card shows it, with its date (Fusion's).
@type {function({name: string, date: ?string}): string}

decls.name: placeConflict
artistTokenCount
decls.doc:
How many words of two letters or more a credit has (Fusion's).
@type {function(string): number}

decls.name: artistSimilar
decls.doc:
Two artist credit strings alike: a token overlap of 0.8 over the shorter credit (Fusion's; the fallback when a side has no artist MBIDs).
@type {function(string, string): boolean}

@type {string[]}

The signals a group's card can name as shared by every pair (Fusion's).
@type {string[]}
